scope.description: What was revoked: one client's session, all of a person's (everywhere), one class of their own (every_browser_and_app, every_agent), or one client's for every person (client_every_identity).

ended_class.description: For a person's own sign-out everywhere narrowed to one class (scope every_browser_and_app or every_agent): the class of sessions it ended. Absent when every class ended.

kept_class.description: For a person's own sign-out everywhere narrowed to one class: the class of sessions it kept running. Absent when every class ended.
